question: Write an essay on the importance of discipline in student life.
model_answer: Discipline is an important quality in student life. It helps students use their time properly and complete their duties regularly. A disciplined student attends school regularly, follows reasonable rules and completes homework on time. Discipline also helps students plan their studies and avoid unnecessary distractions. It develops self-control, responsibility and confidence. These qualities are useful not only in examinations but also in later life. Therefore, discipline is essential for the balanced development and success of students.

question: Write an essay on the advantages and disadvantages of online learning.
model_answer: Online learning has become an important part of education. It gives students access to lessons, videos, digital books and other learning resources from home. Students can learn at their own pace and revisit difficult topics. It is also useful when attending school physically is difficult. However, online learning can cause distractions and excessive screen time. Some students may have poor internet access or lack a suitable device. It can also reduce direct interaction with teachers and classmates. Therefore, online learning is most effective when used responsibly along with classroom learning.

question: Write an essay on how students can contribute to protecting the environment.
model_answer: Students can play an important role in protecting the environment. They can save water and electricity, avoid unnecessary plastic and keep their surroundings clean. Planting and caring for trees can improve the local environment. Students can also practise waste segregation and encourage their families to reduce waste. Schools can organise eco-clubs, cleanliness drives and awareness programmes. Small habits developed by young people can influence the wider community. Therefore, students should understand that protecting nature is a shared responsibility.

Subject: Concern about plastic waste in our town

Sir/Madam,
Through the columns of your newspaper, I wish to draw attention to the growing problem of plastic waste in our town. Plastic bags and packaging are often thrown in public places and drains, causing pollution and blocking drainage systems. The authorities should ensure regular collection, waste segregation and proper disposal. Citizens should also reduce the use of single-use plastic and use reusable alternatives. I request your newspaper to highlight this issue and create public awareness.

Yours faithfully,
[Name]
